book.name: 1 Tesalonaika
book.title: Mo꞉fo꞉s Agel We Fo꞉l Eyo꞉ Tesalonaika Kaluka꞉isalemo꞉ Sa꞉sa꞉liga꞉fo꞉

content: Godeya꞉lo꞉ asulab man a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ kudu hamana

Ni nao i, to nolo꞉ a꞉sa꞉ma꞉nigo꞉l. Godelo꞉ sagalema꞉no꞉ man a꞉no꞉ giliyo꞉ kudu hamana꞉ki, niliyo꞉ tamin amio꞉ gimo꞉wo꞉ wido꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, gio꞉ kudu ha꞉na꞉lab. Ko꞉sega o꞉go꞉ gio꞉ man a꞉no꞉ wa꞉ka halale a꞉kudu ha꞉na꞉melea꞉ki, Ya꞉su Alana꞉ wi amio꞉ niliyo꞉ to a꞉no꞉ wa꞉ka halale so꞉lo꞉l.
Nilo꞉ Ya꞉su Alana꞉ wi amilo꞉ to ko꞉lo꞉ fanda wido꞉ a꞉no꞉ giliyo꞉ asulo꞉.
Godeya꞉lo꞉ asulab aumbo꞉ we. Gio꞉ Godeya꞉ eno꞉le dowaki, digalo꞉ dowa꞉bi. Gio꞉ uwo꞉wo꞉ dia꞉so꞉bo.
Gio꞉ malilo꞉ man o꞉lia꞉ digalo꞉ man a꞉no꞉lia꞉yo꞉ kudu ha꞉naki, ginin asulo꞉ a꞉no꞉ tilidowa꞉bi.
Ha꞉la꞉ kaluka꞉isaleya꞉lo꞉ Godeyo꞉ mo꞉asulaki, inido꞉ uwo꞉ dia꞉no꞉ asulab aundo꞉ kudu ha꞉na꞉sen o꞉leaumbo꞉ giliyo꞉ dimida꞉so꞉bo.

A꞉la꞉gakiyo꞉, giliyo꞉ Keliso gao nowo꞉mbo꞉wo꞉ mogago꞉wo꞉ mo꞉dimidaki, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ inin ingayo꞉ afa dia꞉so꞉bo. Kalu abeyo꞉ man mogago꞉lo꞉ dimidab a꞉no꞉ Gode eyo꞉ e falasila꞉ma꞉ib a꞉la꞉bo꞉ niliyo꞉ tamina hagugu sio꞉.
Mo꞉wo꞉ Gode eyo꞉ nio꞉ man mogago꞉ dimidama꞉ki ho꞉ido꞉ma. Eyo꞉ nio꞉ man digalo꞉ kudu ha꞉na꞉sa꞉ga꞉, malilo꞉le doma꞉ki ho꞉ido꞉.
A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ kalu abeyo꞉ to nilo꞉ wido꞉l welo꞉ gola ba꞉dab a꞉no꞉, kaluwa꞉ towo꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ gola ba꞉daba. Malilo꞉ Mama gimo꞉lo꞉ dimia꞉sen Gode E ko꞉lo꞉ gola ba꞉dab.
Gode eyo꞉ gegeledo꞉ ha꞉fo꞉ disa꞉ma꞉no꞉ man a꞉no꞉ gininbo꞉wo꞉ wido꞉ ko꞉lo꞉, nio꞉ to a꞉no꞉ wa꞉ka sa꞉sa꞉lima꞉no꞉wo꞉ aundo꞉ma.

Hendele, gio꞉ Masedonia hen amilo꞉ nao o꞉lia꞉ nado o꞉lia꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ Keliso sab a꞉no꞉ tambomo꞉wo꞉ ha꞉fo꞉wo꞉ disa꞉la꞉sen. Ko꞉sega ni nao i, gio꞉ man a꞉no꞉ wa꞉ka halale a꞉kudu ha꞉na꞉melea꞉kiyo꞉, niliyo꞉ gimo꞉wo꞉ halale so꞉lo꞉l.

Gio꞉ ha꞉salo꞉ mesa꞉no꞉ man a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ kudu ha꞉na꞉bi. Gio꞉ kelego꞉ noma꞉lo꞉ dimidabo꞉ mo꞉sa꞉laki, kelego꞉ go꞉no꞉ndo꞉wo꞉ dinafa tilidowa꞉bi. Gio꞉ bo꞉sulakima, go꞉no꞉n dagiya꞉ nanogo꞉ dimida꞉bi. Nililo꞉ tamin amilo꞉ gimo꞉lo꞉ sio꞉ o꞉leaumbo꞉ wa꞉ka a꞉so꞉lo꞉l.
Gio꞉ a꞉la꞉dimidalikiyo꞉, ha꞉la꞉ kaluka꞉isaleya꞉yo꞉ gililo꞉ man dimido꞉ a꞉no꞉ ba꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉, ge hendele digalo꞉ kalu a꞉la꞉asuluma꞉ib. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ gio꞉ nowo꞉mbo꞉ asuwa꞉foma꞉kiyo꞉ mo꞉asuluma꞉ib.
Ya꞉su amilo꞉ tilida꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉lo꞉ sowo꞉ kaluka꞉isale

Nao gio꞉, kaluka꞉isale sowab amio꞉, ha꞉la꞉ kalu iliyo꞉ misio꞉ mo꞉ba꞉ba꞉no꞉lo꞉b a꞉lakiyo꞉ nofolo꞉wo꞉ alan dowa꞉sen ko꞉lo꞉, gio꞉ a꞉la꞉bo꞉ dimidabena꞉kiyo꞉, sowab kaluka꞉isale amilo꞉ fa꞉la꞉doma꞉ibo꞉, gimo꞉wo꞉ fanda sa꞉ma꞉nigo꞉l.
Nililo꞉ tilidabuwo꞉ we. Ya꞉suwo꞉ sowa꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, a꞉dasilia꞉gane ko꞉lo꞉, kaluka꞉isale abeyo꞉ eya tilida꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉lo꞉ sowa꞉lab a꞉no꞉, Gode eyo꞉ Ya꞉su o꞉lia꞉ tililia꞉ mia꞉ib.
Ya꞉su Alana꞉lo꞉ to wido꞉wo꞉ we, niliyo꞉ gimo꞉wo꞉ sa꞉ma꞉nigo꞉l. Alando꞉ yab ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉, kaluka꞉isale ni mela꞉no꞉lo꞉ o꞉sab we tamin amio꞉ mo꞉ha꞉na꞉ib. Sowo꞉ kaluka꞉isale i a꞉no꞉ ko꞉le ha꞉na꞉ib.

Ya꞉su Alan e Hebene a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ yakiyo꞉, eyo꞉ towo꞉ halale ho꞉idaki, ma꞉mul misa꞉ kalu eyo꞉lo꞉ towo꞉ sa꞉laki, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Godeya꞉ belo a꞉no꞉ folalikiyo꞉, Ya꞉suwo꞉ a꞉na tima꞉ib. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ kaluka꞉isale e amilo꞉ tilida꞉da꞉sa꞉ga꞉lo꞉ sowo꞉ i a꞉no꞉, ko꞉le dasilia꞉ga꞉ ha꞉na꞉ib.

A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉yo꞉ Gode eyo꞉ kaluka꞉isale mela꞉no꞉lo꞉ o꞉lab nio꞉lo꞉ dia꞉ga꞉, ni o꞉lia꞉ sowo꞉ dasilia꞉gane a꞉no꞉lia꞉yo꞉ kola꞉ usa kegea꞉sa꞉ga꞉, Alano꞉ akin amio꞉ ua galilia꞉ib. A꞉la꞉go꞉ko꞉lo꞉ nio꞉ Alan o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ mela꞉no꞉ mela꞉no꞉ mela꞉ib.
A꞉la꞉dimidama꞉ib ko꞉lo꞉, to we gegelebo꞉ asulo꞉wo꞉ halaido꞉ doma꞉ki sa꞉la꞉lubi.
